children: The market needs more U.S. liquefied natural gas because it is the cheapest form of LNG at today's prices, Trafigura's chief executive said on Tuesday.

"We need more. It is the most flexible source of LNG in the world. At today's prices, it is the cheapest form of LNG in the world. Luckily more is coming on over the next three-to-four years," Richard Holtum said at an energy forum in Bangkok.
